Summary: 7 requirements assessed: 4 satisfied, 3 in conflict with the design, 0 partially covered, 0 not addressed, 0 with unclear design wording, 0 not assessable. Conflicts: REQ-002, REQ-003, REQ-005.

RequirementComparisons.RequirementStatement: REQ-001: The system shall authenticate users using multifactor authentication (MFA) for all online banking sessions.
RequirementComparisons.DesignStatement: DESIGN-001: Users will authenticate using a username and password; MFA setup will be mandated for all users.
RequirementComparisons.ComparisonReasoning: The design mandates MFA setup for all users, matching the requirement's authentication requirement.

RequirementComparisons.RequirementStatement: REQ-002: The system shall complete 99% of fund transfers within 2 seconds under 1,000 concurrent users.
RequirementComparisons.DesignStatement: DESIGN-002: The transfer API will target a response time of 2.5 seconds for 95% of requests under 1,000 concurrent users.
RequirementComparisons.ComparisonReasoning: Time 2.5 s > 2 s and share 95% < 99%: less strict for both metrics.
RequirementComparisons.Explanation: The design allows slower responses for a smaller share of requests than the requirement demands.
RequirementComparisons.Recommendation: Resolve the conflict between REQ-002 and DESIGN-002 (99%; 2 seconds; 1,000 concurrent users vs 95%; 2.5 seconds; 1,000 concurrent users) with the responsible stakeholders and align the requirement and design statements.

RequirementComparisons.RequirementStatement: REQ-003: The system shall prevent duplicate debits and credits when a transfer request is retried.
RequirementComparisons.DesignStatement: DESIGN-003: The transfer API will retry failed transfer operations automatically without an idempotency mechanism.
RequirementComparisons.ComparisonReasoning: The design retries failed transfers without idempotency, which violates the requirement to prevent duplicate debits/credits on retry.
RequirementComparisons.Explanation: Retries without idempotency can cause duplicate debits and credits when transfer requests are retried.
RequirementComparisons.Recommendation: Resolve the conflict between REQ-003 and DESIGN-003 with the responsible stakeholders and align the requirement and design statements.

RequirementComparisons.RequirementStatement: REQ-004: Every successful fund transfer shall debit the source account and credit the destination account exactly once.
RequirementComparisons.DesignStatement: DESIGN-004: The system will debit the source account and credit the destination account using two independent database transactions.
RequirementComparisons.ComparisonReasoning: The design uses two independent database transactions to debit and credit, ensuring exactly once processing.

RequirementComparisons.RequirementStatement: REQ-005: The system shall recover from a regional outage with a recovery time objective (RTO) of 30 minutes and a recovery point objective (RPO) of 5 minutes.
RequirementComparisons.DesignStatement: DESIGN-005: The system will replicate transaction data to a secondary region every 5 minutes and target recovery within 60 minutes.
RequirementComparisons.ComparisonReasoning: RTO 60 min > 30 min: less strict; RPO 5 min = 5 min: equal.
RequirementComparisons.Explanation: The design targets a longer recovery time than the requirement demands.
RequirementComparisons.Recommendation: Resolve the conflict between REQ-005 and DESIGN-005 (30 minutes; 5 minutes vs 60 minutes; 5 minutes) with the responsible stakeholders and align the requirement and design statements.

RequirementComparisons.RequirementStatement: REQ-006: Transaction audit records shall be retained for 10 years and protected against unauthorized modification.
RequirementComparisons.DesignStatement: DESIGN-006: Transaction audit records will be retained for 10 years in a standard database table, with update and delete permissions granted to application administrators.
RequirementComparisons.ComparisonReasoning: Retention period: 10 years = 10 years, so the design meets the requirement.

RequirementComparisons.RequirementStatement: REQ-007: All data transmitted between application components shall be encrypted in transit.
RequirementComparisons.DesignStatement: DESIGN-007: All external API traffic will use HTTPS; internal service-to-service communication will use HTTP within the private network.
RequirementComparisons.ComparisonReasoning: The design uses HTTPS for external traffic and HTTP for internal service-to-service communication within the private network.
